clauses.quote: The teacher shall have the right to answer any material filed,
his or her answer shall be reviewed by the Human Resources director and attached to the file copy.
All legally privileged references and information shall be held in confidence
clauses.subject_text: All legally privileged references and information
clauses.notes: Confidentiality obligation primarily protects the district's legal privilege and administrative process.

clauses.quote: Teachers who claim that material in their file is inaccurate shall be entitled to an informal hearing on the matter pursuant to Article 6.4.
clauses.subject_text: Teachers who claim that material in their file is inaccurate

clauses.quote: Material will be removed from the teacher's file when a teacher's claim that it is inaccurate has been sustained.

Complaints, whether verbal or written, shall not be used as the basis for corrective action if the teacher has not received notice of the complaint and its detailed substance and had opportunity to respond to the supervisor within a reasonable period of time following the school or district’s receipt of the complaint.
Teachers may request copies of written complaints or written summaries of verbal complaints.
Hearsay shall not be used as the basis for actions which may be taken against a teacher.
All vacancies for the following school year that become known before June 1 will be posted according to the following schedule.
clauses.subject_text: All vacancies for the following school year that become known before June 1

clauses.quote: On the last district working day before April 1, the Human Resources office will publish the first listing of known elementary vacancies, together with job descriptions, that will occur for the following school year.

On the last district working day before June 1, the Human Resources office will publish the final listing of known elementary vacancies, together with job descriptions, that will occur for the following year.
